prediction.likelyOutcome: 7205 Telegraph has a strong liability case -- the 2015 reallocation appears to violate the zoning-driven 30-space minimum (confirmed even by the Association's own expert) and was adopted by conflicted, non-disclosing Phase I board members -- so a finding of breach at bench trial is more likely than not. Damages, however, are genuinely uncertain because the two experts' appraisal methodologies produce wildly different implied losses at the actual 12-space count (roughly $100,000-$150,000 under the Association's flatter valuation curve versus $900,000-$1,000,000 under plaintiff's steeper one), and any net recovery will likely be reduced by a partial setoff for 7205 Telegraph's unpaid post-2017 assessments.

outcome.description: After a bench trial the Fairfax County Circuit Court entered judgment for 7205 Telegraph on all four counts, awarding $481,434.84 in lost-rent contract damages, a further $6,296.70 for over-assessments, release of the association's liens, and $324,977.60 in attorney's fees and costs. A Court of Appeals panel affirmed on April 25, 2023; rehearing en banc was granted, and on December 19, 2023 the court lifted the stay and left the judgment affirmed.
